display_information.name: MyMultiSig
display_information.description: Sign multisig requests, post new-request notifications, and read chain state from Slack.
display_information.long_description: MyMultiSig brings multisig request notifications and slash commands to Slack. Install the app to a workspace, run /balance or /address-book to read state, and (next release) get a Block Kit message in your channel whenever a new request is proposed or the signing threshold is reached.

slash_commands.description: Show the native balance of a multisig on a chain
List the public labels for an address
Propose a new transaction request (coming soon)
Open a request to sign (coming soon)
